text:

The cable, run by TeleYemen, serves internet to the entire state, as well as several other Arab countries including Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Sudan. 
In a statement, the company said it couldn't switch the country to another underwater or land cable in the region due to the ongoing conflicts in the region.
